title: smol init — inline setup wizard
source_brief: Approved plan v3: interactive-only smol init; configuration presets, optional face with preset/seed/random-once/random-each-run and static preview/reroll, module order and colors, shell instructions, review and explicit create/replace confirmation. No writes on precommit cancel. Design specification only.
assumptions: All wizard behavior is proposed, not implemented or runtime verified.
Nine system modules in presets; optional face is configured separately.
Static previews illustrate semantic output, not faithful terminal execution.
Files may contain local uncommitted changes; this package changes no application source.
Atomic rename prevents partial content; uncooperative concurrent writers can still race the last existing-file snapshot check.
